intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

selected_hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, Maldives Boutique Stay

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Watch the sun melt into the horizon while sipping champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners seeking intimacy and breathtaking natural beauty.

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling Safari at Maaya Thila
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most celebrated snorkeling and diving sites, Maaya Thila, a protected marine area teeming with reef sharks, manta rays, sea turtles, and vibrant coral gardens. A guided snorkeling safari takes you through multiple reef zones with a marine biologist on hand to narrate the underwater ecosystem. Equipment and boat transfer included.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Dine in an extraordinary all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living ocean. Enjoy a candlelit multi-course dinner featuring freshly caught Maldivian seafood, lobster, and tropical desserts while reef fish and rays glide past your table. An unparalleled luxury dining experience that doubles as a romantic honeymoon memory.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Step ashore on a local inhabited island to discover authentic Maldivian culture, traditional crafts, and centuries-old fishing heritage. Visit a local school, mosque, and artisan workshops before joining a hands-on cooking class where you learn to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish broth, and hedhikaa sweet snacks using fresh local ingredients.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk & Stargazing
experiences.description: After dark, walk along a secluded beach glowing with natural bioluminescent plankton that lights up the shoreline in electric blue with every wave. Accompanied by an astronomy guide, you'll also gaze at the Milky Way through a telescope in one of the world's least light-polluted skies. A magical, otherworldly experience ideal for honeymooners seeking wonder and romance.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, Maldives Boutique Stay

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk & Stargazing
experiences.description: After dark, walk along a secluded beach glowing with natural bioluminescent plankton that lights up the shoreline in electric blue with every wave. Accompanied by an astronomy guide, you'll also gaze at the Milky Way through a telescope in one of the world's least light-polluted skies. A magical, otherworldly experience ideal for honeymooners seeking wonder and romance.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration and customs, collect luggage. Take a budget-friendly public ferry from the airport ferry terminal to your guesthouse in North Malé Atoll (approximately $2–5 USD). Check in, freshen up, and explore the local island on foot — discover the beach, nearby shops, and get oriented.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the local beach at sunset to soak in your first Maldivian evening. Watch the sky turn pink and orange over the Indian Ocean. Enjoy a relaxed welcome dinner at a local café near the guesthouse.

meals.breakfast: On the plane
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at the airport — try a local short-eat snack like mas huni roshi (tuna flatbread) from a café for under $5
meals.dinner: Local island restaurant near guesthouse — try fresh grilled fish with rice and curry for $8–12 per person

day_by_day.notes: Public ferries are the most budget-friendly transfer option ($2–5). Speedboat transfers cost $25–40. Confirm ferry schedule in advance with your guesthouse. Exchange some USD to MVR (Maldivian Rufiyaa) at the airport for local purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early and enjoy the sunrise from the beach — a magical and completely free experience. After breakfast, head to the house reef for a morning snorkeling session. Most budget guesthouses in North Malé Atoll provide basic snorkel gear for free or rent it for $5–8. Explore the colorful coral gardens and spot tropical fish, sea turtles, and reef sharks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget group snorkeling excursion offered by your guesthouse or a local dive shop. These typically visit 2–3 snorkeling spots including a sandbank and a coral reef for $25–35 per person. Look out for manta rays and whale sharks depending on the season.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the island and rinse off. Walk along the bikini beach (designated swimming beach) to watch the sunset. Head into the local village to browse small shops and interact with locals.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — mas huni (tuna and coconut) with roshi flatbread and black tea, typically $4–6 or included in room rate
meals.lunch: Packed lunch provided on the snorkeling trip or grab a local short-eat from a tea shop for $3–5
meals.dinner: Beachside local restaurant — fresh catch of the day with coconut rice and curry for $10–14 per person

day_by_day.notes: North Malé Atoll has excellent house reefs. Ask your guesthouse which time of day has the best visibility. Wear reef-safe sunscreen to protect the coral ecosystem.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga or meditation session on the beach (many guesthouses offer free or low-cost sessions). Afterward, explore the local island's interior — visit the Friday Mosque if accessible, observe local life, and wander through colorful streets lined with coral-stone walls.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a bicycle from the guesthouse ($5–8/day) and cycle around the entire island. Visit the local harbor to watch fishermen bring in their catch. Spend time at the sandbank if reachable by a short boat trip ($5–10 per person arranged through the guesthouse).
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk & Stargazing — after dark, join this magical experience walking along a secluded beach glowing with natural bioluminescent plankton. The water and wet sand light up electric blue with every step. Pair this with stargazing away from light pollution for a truly romantic and unforgettable honeymoon memory.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — fresh tropical fruit platter with coconut pancakes and coffee for $5–7
meals.lunch: Local tea shop lunch — garudhiya (tuna broth soup) with rice and lime for $4–6
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner for two at a guesthouse rooftop or beachside setting — grilled lobster or snapper with salad for $15–20 per person (a splurge worth it for the honeymoon atmosphere)

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescent experience is best on darker nights with no moon or minimal moonlight. Check the lunar calendar and confirm with your guesthouse. Bring a light jacket as evenings can be breezy.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin-watching cruise — a budget group boat trip ($20–30 per person) that departs at sunrise when dolphins are most active. Spinner dolphins are commonly seen in North Malé Atoll and often swim alongside the boat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the island and spend the afternoon snorkeling the house reef independently with rented gear. Focus on a different section of the reef than Day 2. Look for octopus, lionfish, and moray eels hiding in the coral.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset fishing trip — join a traditional Maldivian hand-line fishing excursion ($20–25 per person). Fish with locals using traditional methods, and if you catch something, the guesthouse kitchen can often cook it for you for a small fee.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the early cruise — bread with jam and tea from the guesthouse for $3–4
meals.lunch: Cook your catch from the fishing trip at the guesthouse kitchen, or have a local rice and curry plate at a café for $5–8
meals.dinner: Freshly prepared fish from your fishing trip cooked by the guesthouse chef — a unique and romantic dining experience for $5–10 cooking fee

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin sightings are not guaranteed but very common in this region. The best months are March–April. Book the fishing trip the day before to secure spots.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Malé city — take the public ferry to the capital ($1–2 each way). Visit the Grand Friday Mosque (Masjid Al-Sultan Muhammad Thakurufaanu Al Auzam), the National Museum of Maldives ($3 entry), and the colorful fish market at the harbor.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Malé — browse the local market for souvenirs like lacquerware, shell jewelry, and woven mats. Visit the Maldives Victory shipwreck viewpoint and the waterfront promenade. Grab street food from local vendors.
day_by_day.evening: Return by public ferry before sunset. Enjoy a quiet evening at the guesthouse — watch the stars from the rooftop or beach and reflect on the week so far. Perfect romantic evening for couples.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast before departure — $4–6
meals.lunch: Malé local eatery — hedhikaa (Maldivian short eats) platter with samosas, keemia fish rolls, and gulha for $5–8
meals.dinner: Back on the island — local restaurant rice and curry with fresh fish for $8–12

day_by_day.notes: Malé is a compact city easily walkable in half a day. Dress modestly when visiting mosques (shoulders and knees covered). Friday prayers mean the mosque may be closed to tourists around midday Friday.

day_by_day.morning: Guided snorkeling tour to a famous reef in North Malé Atoll such as Banana Reef or HP Reef — considered among the best snorkeling and diving sites in the Maldives. Book through a local dive center ($30–40 per person for snorkeling). Vibrant hard and soft corals, Napoleon wrasse, and reef sharks are common sights.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax on the private beach or bikini beach. Set up a romantic picnic with fruits, local snacks, and coconut water purchased from the local shop. Read, nap, and enjoy the turquoise lagoon at your own pace.
day_by_day.evening: Second Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk — if you want to experience it again or missed it on Day 3, tonight is another perfect opportunity. The glowing plankton combined with a clear starry sky creates an incredibly romantic atmosphere perfect for honeymooners.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — egg omelet with toast and fresh juice for $5–7
meals.lunch: Picnic lunch on the beach — fresh tropical fruits (mango, papaya, watermelon), local biscuits, and coconut water purchased from island shop for $6–8 total
meals.dinner: Guesthouse or local restaurant — tuna curry with steamed rice and papadum for $8–11

day_by_day.notes: HP Reef (also called the Maldives Victory dive site area) and Banana Reef are iconic. Even non-divers can enjoy these sites while snorkeling on the surface. Wear a rash guard for sun protection during long water sessions.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and rejuvenation day — sleep in and enjoy a slow morning. Many budget guesthouses offer affordable spa treatments such as a 60-minute Maldivian coconut oil massage for $30–50. Treat yourselves to a couples massage for a honeymoon-worthy experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Kayaking around the island — rent kayaks from the guesthouse ($10–15 for 2 hours per kayak) and paddle around the lagoon. Explore the shallow sandbanks and spot marine life from above. Great opportunity for photography.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic sunset walk along the beach holding hands. Watch the green flash at sunset if conditions are right. Head back for a special dinner to celebrate the midpoint of your trip.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent guesthouse breakfast — fresh fruit, yogurt, granola, eggs, and coffee for $7–9
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the guesthouse — fresh salad with grilled chicken or tuna for $8–10
meals.dinner: Splurge dinner at the best local restaurant on the island — seafood BBQ platter for two with lobster, prawns, and fish for $30–40 total — a romantic honeymoon treat

day_by_day.notes: A mid-trip spa day is a great way to recharge. Budget spas on local islands are significantly cheaper than resort spas ($30–50 vs $150–200 at luxury resorts) with comparable quality. Book spa appointments in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise snorkeling session at the house reef — early morning light creates stunning underwater visibility and fewer crowds. Look for sea turtles feeding on seagrass and reef fish beginning their day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Island hopping excursion — join a group day trip ($35–50 per person) visiting 2–3 nearby uninhabited islands or local islands. Typically includes a sandbank stop, snorkeling, and sometimes a visit to a local fishing village.
day_by_day.evening: Photography golden hour on the beach — capture the stunning Maldivian sunset together. Use the long golden light for romantic couple photos on the sandbank or beach. Review photos and plan the rest of the trip.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-snorkel breakfast — banana, granola bar, and tea for $2–3
meals.lunch: Included in the island hopping excursion or packed lunch from guesthouse — tuna sandwiches and fruit
meals.dinner: Local island restaurant — mas riha (Maldivian tuna curry) with rice and fresh coconut sambal for $8–12

day_by_day.notes: Island hopping trips are one of the best value activities in the Maldives. Prices vary — compare options from your guesthouse and local tour operators. Bring sunscreen, water, and a dry bag for your belongings.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater photography or videography session — if you have a waterproof camera or phone case, dedicate this morning to capturing the underwater world during a snorkeling session. Focus on macro photography of nudibranchs, clownfish, and coral details.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby local island by public ferry — experience authentic Maldivian village life, visit a local school or community center (if permitted), and shop for handmade crafts directly from artisans at lower prices than tourist shops.
day_by_day.evening: Stargazing on the beach — the Maldives sits near the equator, offering spectacular views of both northern and southern hemisphere constellations. Lay on the beach with a blanket and identify stars and constellations. A perfect romantic honeymoon evening.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — mas huni with roshi and black tea for $4–6
meals.lunch: Local tea shop on the visited island — short eats and fresh lime juice for $4–6
meals.dinner: Cook-at-guesthouse option — buy fresh fish from the local market and ask the guesthouse kitchen to prepare it for a small fee, or eat at a local restaurant for $8–12

day_by_day.notes: Respect local customs when visiting inhabited islands — dress modestly (cover shoulders and knees), ask permission before photographing people, and be mindful of prayer times. This cultural experience adds depth to the honeymoon trip.

day_by_day.morning: Advanced snorkeling excursion to a channel or thila (underwater pinnacle) — these sites attract larger marine life including grey reef sharks, eagle rays, and schools of barracuda. Book through a local dive center ($30–40 for snorkeling). More experienced snorkelers will love the stronger currents and diverse marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Beach relaxation and journaling — spend the afternoon at the beach reflecting on your honeymoon experiences. Write in a travel journal together, collect shells (only dead ones, not living), and enjoy the peaceful lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk & Stargazing — experience this magical phenomenon one final time. By now you know the best spots on the beach. Walk barefoot through the glowing surf and lie under the stars together — a memory you will cherish forever.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — coconut pancakes with honey and fresh fruit for $5–7
meals.lunch: Post-snorkel lunch at a local café — grilled fish sandwich and fresh coconut water for $7–9
meals.dinner: Romantic beachside dinner — request a special table setup from your guesthouse for a candlelit dinner on the sand (many budget guesthouses accommodate this for a small fee or free) with seafood for $15–20 per person

day_by_day.notes: A candlelit beach dinner can be arranged through most guesthouses for $10–20 extra setup fee. This creates a luxury resort-like romantic experience at a fraction of the cost — perfect for a honeymoon splurge moment.

day_by_day.morning: Freediving introduction session — many dive centers in North Malé Atoll offer beginner freediving experiences ($40–60 per person). Learn breath-holding techniques and dive deeper than snorkeling to get closer to marine life. A thrilling and unique experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Souvenir shopping on the local island — buy lacquerware boxes, traditional Maldivian woven mats (thundu kunaa), sarongs, and local spices. Bargain respectfully and support local artisans. Pack purchases carefully to protect them for the journey home.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset dhoni cruise — rent a traditional Maldivian wooden boat (dhoni) with a local skipper for a private sunset cruise ($50–80 for the couple for 1.5–2 hours). Sail into the golden sunset with cold drinks and enjoy complete privacy on the water.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — fresh fruit smoothie bowl with granola for $6–8
meals.lunch: Local restaurant — fish and chips Maldivian style with fresh salad for $8–10
meals.dinner: Guesthouse dinner — chicken or fish curry with yellow rice, papadum, and mango chutney for $9–12

day_by_day.notes: A private sunset dhoni cruise is one of the most romantic budget-friendly luxury experiences available in the Maldives. Negotiate the price with local boat operators directly for the best rate. Bring a light wrap or jacket for the sea breeze.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling session at your favorite reef spot from the trip — revisit the house reef or the best site you discovered. Take time to say goodbye to the underwater world and spot any marine life you may have missed. Bring an underwater camera for final photos.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack bags and prepare for departure the next day. Do a final walk around the island, visit any spots you loved, and take photos of the island, guesthouse, and local scenes to remember the trip. Leave a review for your guesthouse to support local tourism.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner — celebrate your 13-day Maldives honeymoon adventure with a special dinner. Choose your favorite restaurant from the trip or try a new local spot. Toast to your honeymoon and the incredible memories made.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — full spread of mas huni, roshi, eggs, fruit, and coffee for $6–8
meals.lunch: Light lunch at a local café — tuna salad wrap and fresh juice for $7–9
meals.dinner: Farewell honeymoon dinner — grilled whole snapper with coconut rice, tropical salad, and a dessert of watalappan (coconut custard pudding) for $15–22 per person

day_by_day.notes: Watalappan is a traditional Maldivian/Sri Lankan dessert made with coconut milk, jaggery, and eggs — a must-try sweet ending to your trip. Confirm your ferry schedule to the airport for the next day and set an early alarm if needed.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach — wake up early for one last Maldivian sunrise. Walk barefoot on the sand, dip your feet in the warm Indian Ocean, and take in the beauty one last time. A deeply romantic and emotional final morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of the guesthouse (confirm checkout time — usually 11:00–12:00). Take the public ferry back to Velana International Airport ($2–5 per person). Arrive at the airport with plenty of time. Browse duty-free shops for any last-minute gifts — Maldivian black coral jewelry, local honey, or vanilla.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Velana International Airport. Reflect on 13 incredible days in paradise — the bioluminescent beaches, vibrant coral reefs, romantic sunsets, and authentic local experiences that made this budget honeymoon truly unforgettable.

meals.breakfast: Final guesthouse breakfast — make it special with a full spread and take your time savoring it for $6–8
meals.lunch: Airport café or restaurant — Maldivian short eats or an international option for $10–15
meals.dinner: On the plane or at a layover airport

day_by_day.notes: Budget summary estimate for 13 days per couple: Accommodation $600–900, Food $400–600, Activities & excursions $400–600, Transport $50–100, Shopping $100–200 = Total approximately $1,550–2,400 for two people. Significantly cheaper than a luxury resort stay while still experiencing the magic of the Maldives authentically.

trip_options.title: Classic Maldives Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight LH arrives at 13:00 at Velana International Airport (Malé)
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport arrival, immigration, and baggage collection. Transfer via speedboat or seaplane to your boutique stay in North Malé Atoll (approximately 20–45 minutes). Check in, freshen up, and take a leisurely stroll around the resort island to get your bearings. Enjoy a welcome drink on your overwater terrace or beach villa and soak in the first views of the turquoise lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — board a traditionally chartered Maldivian dhoni boat for a romantic golden-hour sail across the Indian Ocean. Watch the sun dip below the horizon with chilled champagne in hand, perfect for setting the honeymoon mood.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight
meals.lunch: Light snack or welcome refreshments at the resort upon check-in
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant — opt for the fresh catch of the day with a local fish curry and coconut rice, priced in the mid-range set menu tier

day_by_day.notes: Confirm speedboat transfer timing with the resort in advance. Keep luggage light and accessible for the water transfer. The sunset dhoni cruise is best booked through the resort concierge upon arrival — request a 17:30 departure to catch the optimal sunset window in March.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early and enjoy the sunrise from your villa terrace. After breakfast, head to the resort's house reef for a guided snorkeling orientation session. Explore the coral gardens just off the beach, spotting reef fish, sea turtles, and vibrant corals — a perfect gentle introduction to the underwater world of North Malé Atoll.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax on the resort's private beach with a good book and a fresh coconut. Optional: rent a stand-up paddleboard or kayak from the water sports center and explore the calm lagoon at your own pace. Visit the resort spa for a 60-minute couples' relaxation massage — a mid-range treatment ideal for honeymooners.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the beach at dusk as the sky turns pink and purple. Enjoy cocktails at the resort's beachside bar before heading to dinner.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort — fresh tropical fruits, eggs made to order, pastries, and freshly brewed Maldivian coffee
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the beach shack or pool bar — grilled fish wraps, fresh salads, and fruit smoothies
meals.dinner: Candlelit dinner on the beach arranged by the resort — a romantic set menu with grilled lobster or mahi-mahi, paired with a local mocktail or house wine

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort's dive center about house reef snorkeling conditions and best entry points. The couples' spa massage should be booked at least a day in advance to secure preferred timing.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Reef Snorkeling Safari at Maaya Thila — depart by speedboat to one of the Maldives' most celebrated marine protected sites. Spend the morning exploring the pinnacle reef teeming with nurse sharks, eagle rays, Napoleon wrasse, and schools of colorful reef fish. A certified guide accompanies the group to point out hidden marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort after the safari. Enjoy a relaxed afternoon at the infinity pool overlooking the ocean. Optional: visit the resort's boutique to pick up a small souvenir or local handicraft. Take a nap in your villa — the morning snorkeling may be exhilarating!
day_by_day.evening: Sundowner drinks at the resort's overwater bar. Watch the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean from your villa deck.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before the snorkeling departure — light continental spread with fruit, yogurt, and coffee
meals.lunch: Packed snorkeling safari lunch included with the excursion, or a fresh seafood lunch at the resort upon return
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's à la carte restaurant — try the Maldivian tuna curry (mas riha) with roshi flatbread, a local specialty at a mid-range price point

day_by_day.notes: Maaya Thila is located in Ari Atoll and requires a longer speedboat journey — confirm departure times with the resort activity desk the evening before. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a rash guard, and an underwater camera or GoPro for the safari.

day_by_day.morning: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class — take a short speedboat ride to a nearby local inhabited island. Walk through the village with a local guide, visit the Friday mosque, observe traditional lacquerwork and mat-weaving artisans, and then join a hands-on cooking class learning to prepare authentic Maldivian dishes like garudhiya (tuna broth), bis keemiya (pastry), and fresh coconut sambol.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort with your new culinary knowledge. Spend the afternoon unwinding by the pool or on the beach. Optional: book a snorkeling session at a nearby sandbank for a quieter, more intimate experience.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic dinner for two — use what you learned in the cooking class to inspire your order, or request a special romantic dinner setup on the beach from the resort concierge.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort before departure for the cultural tour
meals.lunch: Lunch is included as part of the cooking class experience — enjoy the dishes you prepared together with the local family
meals.dinner: Beachside romantic dinner at the resort — grilled seafood platter for two with tropical dessert and sparkling water or house wine

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting the local island — covered shoulders and knees are respectful and required near the mosque. This excursion offers a wonderful cultural contrast to the resort bubble and is highly recommended for a well-rounded Maldives experience.

day_by_day.morning: Slow, leisurely morning — sleep in and enjoy breakfast in bed if your villa offers in-room dining. Afterward, take a guided snorkeling tour along the resort's house reef with a marine biologist on staff (many boutique resorts offer this). Learn to identify specific coral species and fish families.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort spa for a longer couples' treatment — a 90-minute traditional Maldivian coconut oil scrub and massage using local ingredients like pandan leaf and sandalwood. This is a luxurious mid-range indulgence worth experiencing.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk & Stargazing — after dark, walk along a secluded beach glowing with natural bioluminescent plankton. Watch the shoreline light up electric blue with every wave and footstep. Afterward, lie on beach mats and stargaze with a guide pointing out southern hemisphere constellations and Maldivian navigation lore.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast or late buffet — fresh juices, tropical fruit platter, eggs, and pastries
meals.lunch: Casual pool bar lunch — fish and chips, Caesar salad, or a fresh fruit bowl
meals.dinner: Light dinner before the evening excursion — a simple pasta or grilled chicken at the resort café, keeping the evening free for the bioluminescence experience

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescence is most vivid during new moon phases — check lunar calendar for March 2027 to optimize timing. Avoid using phone flashlights during the walk to allow eyes to adjust and to preserve the natural glow effect.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin-watching cruise — many resorts in North Malé Atoll offer sunrise speedboat excursions to spot spinner dolphins leaping in the bow wake. This is a magical, romantic experience and a highlight for many couples.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return for a late breakfast, then spend the afternoon on a private sandbank picnic. Arrange with the resort to be dropped off on a deserted sandbank with a picnic basket, snorkeling gear, and a bottle of sparkling wine — pure paradise for honeymooners.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort as the sun sets. Enjoy a relaxing evening with cocktails on your villa deck, listening to the ocean. Optional: in-villa movie night with popcorn if the resort offers this amenity.

meals.breakfast: Late breakfast after the dolphin cruise — full hot buffet with Maldivian and international options
meals.lunch: Sandbank picnic arranged by the resort — cold cuts, cheese, tropical fruit, sandwiches, and sparkling water or wine
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant — try the grilled snapper with coconut cream sauce and a mango sorbet dessert

day_by_day.notes: Book the sandbank picnic at least 2 days in advance and confirm weather conditions. The resort will typically provide snorkeling equipment, beach mats, and an umbrella for shade. Apply waterproof sunscreen generously as sandbanks have no shade.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint rest day — enjoy a full slow morning with no scheduled activities. Take a long swim in the lagoon, practice yoga on the beach (many boutique resorts offer complimentary morning yoga), or simply read and relax.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience — the crown jewel of the trip. Travel to a nearby resort (accessible by speedboat) to dine in an all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living ocean. Enjoy a carefully curated candlelit lunch menu with panoramic views of reef fish, rays, and coral formations drifting past your table.
day_by_day.evening: Return to your resort in the late afternoon. Enjoy a quiet, romantic evening on the beach — collect shells, walk along the waterline, and watch the stars come out. No structured activities tonight — just pure togetherness.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely in-room breakfast or poolside breakfast — fresh smoothie bowls, granola, and tropical fruit
meals.lunch: The Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience — a prix fixe tasting menu with 3–4 courses featuring fresh ocean-inspired cuisine (this is the splurge meal of the trip, budget accordingly)
meals.dinner: Light dinner at the resort — a simple mezze platter, flatbreads, and fresh juice at the casual beachside café

day_by_day.notes: The underwater restaurant requires an advance reservation — book as early as possible, ideally before departure from home. Dress code is typically smart casual (no flip-flops). This is the most premium dining experience of the trip and worth every moment.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling at a nearby coral garden — the resort activity desk can recommend a different site from previous days to keep the underwater experience fresh. Look out for seahorses, octopus, and nudibranchs in shallower reef areas.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort island on foot — visit the garden, the turtle or ray feeding station if available, and the gift shop. Spend the late afternoon at the overwater hammock or infinity pool, sipping fresh lime sodas and watching the boats drift by.
day_by_day.evening: Second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise — book a second evening cruise for a different sunset experience. This time, bring a journal or sketchbook and reflect on the journey so far. The crew can arrange a small charcuterie board or fresh fruit platter on board.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort — make the most of the spread with fresh pastries, tropical juices, and a hot egg station
meals.lunch: Lunch at the resort's beachside grill — freshly grilled reef fish with lemon butter, coleslaw, and sweet potato fries
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort restaurant — request a window table with an ocean view and try the seafood pasta or Maldivian-style biryani

day_by_day.notes: If the resort has a coral restoration program or marine biology talk scheduled this week, this is a great day to attend — it adds meaningful depth to the snorkeling experiences and is usually complimentary.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a peaceful morning. Optional: take a beginner scuba diving discovery session with the resort's PADI dive center — a 2-hour introductory dive in the lagoon with a certified instructor, no experience required. A wonderful activity for snorkelers wanting to go deeper.
day_by_day.afternoon: Couples' cooking session at the resort — some boutique resorts offer informal cooking demonstrations with their head chef. Learn to make a Maldivian dessert like bondi (coconut and rice balls) or foni boakibaa (rice cake), and enjoy what you make together.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a special in-villa romantic dinner — request the resort to set up a private candlelit dinner on your villa deck or in a beach cabana with fairy lights, flower petals, and a personalized menu. This is a classic honeymoon evening experience.

meals.breakfast: Late breakfast — avocado toast, fresh fruit, and a pot of Maldivian tea (sai) on the villa terrace
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the pool bar — grilled chicken skewers, fresh salad, and a mocktail
meals.dinner: Private in-villa candlelit dinner — a 3-course set menu curated by the resort chef, typically featuring a seafood starter, grilled main, and a chocolate fondant or tropical fruit dessert

day_by_day.notes: The private in-villa dinner setup usually incurs a small additional fee at mid-range boutique resorts — confirm pricing and menu options with the concierge 2 days in advance. Request flower arrangements and candles for the full romantic atmosphere.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to a nearby uninhabited island — arrange with the resort for a half-day excursion to a deserted island with pristine white sand and crystal-clear water. Snorkel the surrounding reef, explore the island on foot, and enjoy the solitude of having a piece of paradise entirely to yourselves.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by early afternoon. Spend the rest of the day at the spa — book a 2-hour couples' spa journey including a foot soak, body wrap, and facial using local ingredients like aloe vera and coconut.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk & Stargazing (second visit if the first was exceptional, or skip if satisfied) — alternatively, enjoy a quiet evening at the resort bar with live acoustic music if available, sipping cocktails under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Early buffet breakfast before the island day trip
meals.lunch: Packed picnic lunch on the uninhabited island — prepared by the resort with sandwiches, fruit, and cold drinks in a cooler box
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's à la carte restaurant — try something new from the menu such as the tuna tartare starter and the coconut-crusted prawns as a main

day_by_day.notes: Bring plenty of reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and a reusable water bottle for the uninhabited island trip. There are no facilities on uninhabited islands, so plan accordingly. This day is one of the most memorable of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling excursion — revisit your favorite reef site from the trip or ask the dive center to recommend a new location you haven't explored yet. Spend a full morning underwater, taking your time to observe and appreciate the marine ecosystem one last time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisurely afternoon — pack any non-essential items and begin gentle trip organization. Take a final swim in the lagoon, enjoy the pool, and sit on the beach for a long, reflective afternoon. Visit the gift shop for last-minute souvenirs — local lacquerwork, sarongs, or Maldivian spice sets make wonderful gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class (if not done earlier, or revisit a local island for a sunset walk and tea with a local family — arrange through the resort).

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast — indulge in everything you've loved throughout the trip one more time
meals.lunch: Lunch at the resort beach grill — a final fresh grilled fish with tropical slaw and iced coconut water
meals.dinner: Special farewell dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — splurge slightly on a tasting menu or chef's special to celebrate the end of a beautiful honeymoon chapter

day_by_day.notes: Begin confirming departure logistics with the resort concierge — speedboat or seaplane transfer timing, baggage allowances for water transfers, and airport check-in requirements for the return flight.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise — set an early alarm and walk to the beach to watch the sun rise over the Indian Ocean together. This quiet, unplanned moment often becomes the most cherished memory of the trip. Return for a long, indulgent breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check-out day preparation — settle any outstanding resort bills, return snorkeling equipment, and pack. If check-out is at noon and the flight is later, arrange a late check-out or a day-use area with the resort so you can shower and relax comfortably before the transfer.
day_by_day.evening: Transfer back to Velana International Airport (Malé) via speedboat. Allow ample time for the journey and airport procedures. Enjoy a final Maldivian fish soup or short eats (hedhikaa) at an airport café before boarding.

meals.breakfast: Final full breakfast at the resort — savor every bite of the tropical spread
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort or airport — grilled sandwich, fresh juice, and a slice of coconut cake
meals.dinner: Dinner at the airport or on the flight — if time permits, try the airport's local café for a final plate of mas huni (tuna and coconut breakfast salad) or a simple curry

day_by_day.notes: Double-check passport, travel documents, and all valuables before leaving the villa. Water transfers to the airport can be affected by weather — allow extra time in your schedule. Take one last photo from the boat as the resort island disappears into the horizon.

day_by_day.morning: Travel day — in-flight or transit depending on your return routing. Reflect on the incredible 13-day journey through one of the world's most beautiful destinations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue travel home. If there is a long layover, rest in an airport lounge or explore the transit city briefly.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive home, carrying memories of turquoise lagoons, bioluminescent beaches, coral reefs, and candlelit dinners under the Maldivian stars.

meals.breakfast: In-flight meal or airport café
meals.lunch: In-flight meal or layover dining
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or home arrival dinner

day_by_day.notes: This day is a buffer travel day included to account for long-haul return flights from the Maldives. Use the flight time to organize your photos, write travel journal entries, and begin planning your next adventure together.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, Maldives Boutique Stay

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Watch the sun melt into the horizon while sipping champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners seeking intimacy and breathtaking natural beauty.

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling Safari at Maaya Thila
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most celebrated snorkeling and diving sites, Maaya Thila, a protected marine area teeming with reef sharks, manta rays, sea turtles, and vibrant coral gardens. A guided snorkeling safari takes you through multiple reef zones with a marine biologist on hand to narrate the underwater ecosystem. Equipment and boat transfer included.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Dine in an extraordinary all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living ocean. Enjoy a candlelit multi-course dinner featuring freshly caught Maldivian seafood, lobster, and tropical desserts while reef fish and rays glide past your table. An unparalleled luxury dining experience that doubles as a romantic honeymoon memory.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Step ashore on a local inhabited island to discover authentic Maldivian culture, traditional crafts, and centuries-old fishing heritage. Visit a local school, mosque, and artisan workshops before joining a hands-on cooking class where you learn to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish broth, and hedhikaa sweet snacks using fresh local ingredients.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk & Stargazing
experiences.description: After dark, walk along a secluded beach glowing with natural bioluminescent plankton that lights up the shoreline in electric blue with every wave. Accompanied by an astronomy guide, you'll also gaze at the Milky Way through a telescope in one of the world's least light-polluted skies. A magical, otherworldly experience ideal for honeymooners seeking wonder and romance.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight in transit. Arrival at Velana International Airport, Malé at 13:00.
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport meet-and-greet by private resort representative. Enjoy a refreshing welcome drink at the VIP lounge before boarding a private speedboat transfer to your boutique resort in North Malé Atoll (approx. 20–45 min). Settle into your overwater or beach villa, unpack, and take a leisurely first stroll along the resort's pristine private beach to soak in the surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — Board your privately chartered traditional Maldivian dhoni as the sun melts into the Indian Ocean. Sip chilled Champagne, enjoy canapés, and watch the sky turn shades of gold and rose in total seclusion. The perfect romantic welcome to the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Enjoyed on the flight or at Malé airport VIP lounge upon arrival.
meals.lunch: Light à la carte welcome lunch at the resort's main restaurant upon check-in — fresh seafood mezze, tropical fruit platters, and chilled coconut water.
meals.dinner: Intimate beachside dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant. Enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring freshly caught tuna carpaccio, lobster bisque, and grilled reef fish with saffron butter, paired with a premium wine selection.

day_by_day.notes: Arrival day — keep the pace relaxed. Confirm all upcoming experience bookings with the resort concierge during check-in. Request any honeymoon room decorations (rose petals, candles, fruit baskets) to be arranged in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a lavish in-villa breakfast delivered by personal butler — think freshly baked pastries, tropical fruit, eggs cooked to order, and fresh-pressed juices on your private deck overlooking the lagoon. Afterward, spend the morning exploring the resort's house reef with complimentary snorkeling gear. Spot colorful parrotfish, sea turtles, and vibrant coral formations just steps from your villa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Coral Reef Snorkeling Safari at Maaya Thila — Board a private boat to one of the Maldives' most celebrated marine sites. Snorkel above the circular reef teeming with white-tip reef sharks, Napoleon wrasse, manta rays, and kaleidoscopic coral gardens. A certified marine guide accompanies you throughout for a safe and enriching experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a couples' sunset spa ritual at the overwater spa pavilion — enjoy a traditional Maldivian coconut oil massage and floral bath drawn with local herbs, followed by a private jacuzzi session overlooking the ocean.

meals.breakfast: In-villa butler breakfast on your private deck — pastries, tropical fruits, eggs Benedict, fresh juices, and Maldivian black tea.
meals.lunch: Light beach picnic box prepared by the resort chef, enjoyed on the boat between snorkeling sessions — sandwiches, fresh fruit, sparkling water, and chilled lemonade.
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant — choose from a curated seafood menu featuring grilled Maldivian lobster, pan-seared barramundi, and chocolate fondant for dessert. Reserve a table on the outer deck for unobstructed ocean views.

day_by_day.notes: Maaya Thila is best visited in the morning or early afternoon when visibility is at its peak. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only. Confirm snorkeling safari departure time with concierge the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a slow, indulgent morning. After breakfast, take a private yoga session on the beach or on your villa deck led by the resort's resident instructor — a peaceful way to align body and mind with the rhythm of the ocean.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience — Transfer by boat to one of North Malé Atoll's iconic all-glass underwater restaurants. Marvel at the living ocean surrounding you as you enjoy a multi-course gourmet lunch — freshly caught seafood, artisan bread, and decadent desserts — while reef fish and rays glide past the glass walls. An utterly unforgettable romantic dining experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and spend the late afternoon lounging at your private villa pool or the resort's adults-only infinity pool. As the sun sets, enjoy handcrafted cocktails at the overwater bar before a relaxed dinner.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast at the main pavilion — an extravagant spread of international and Maldivian dishes, live egg station, fresh juices, and artisan coffee.
meals.lunch: Multi-course gourmet tasting menu at the Underwater Restaurant — included as part of the experience booking. Pairs with fine wine or curated mocktails.
meals.dinner: Casual yet elegant dinner at the resort's beach grill — wood-fired whole fish, grilled vegetables, and handmade gelato under the stars.

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant experience typically requires advance booking — confirm reservation at least 2 days prior. Dress smart-casual for the underwater restaurant. Photography is encouraged and the experience is highly Instagram-worthy.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a guided sunrise kayaking session around the resort's lagoon — paddle through glassy turquoise waters as the first light of day illuminates the horizon. Return for a leisurely breakfast before spending time relaxing on your private villa deck.
day_by_day.afternoon: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class — Take a short boat ride to a nearby local inhabited island. Wander through traditional coral-stone streets, visit the local mosque, observe traditional lacquerwork and weaving crafts, and then join a hands-on cooking class led by a local family. Learn to prepare authentic Maldivian dishes including mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and roshi flatbread.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk & Stargazing — After dark, walk barefoot along a secluded beach glowing with natural bioluminescent plankton. Every footstep and wave crest shimmers electric blue. A resident astronomer guides you through the Southern Hemisphere's star-filled sky using a high-powered telescope — a truly magical and romantic evening.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — fresh tropical smoothie bowls, avocado toast, Maldivian roshi with coconut sambal, and specialty coffee.
meals.lunch: Authentic Maldivian home-style lunch on the local island as part of the cultural tour — freshly prepared dishes from the cooking class alongside local short eats and sweet tea.
meals.dinner: Romantic private dining setup on the beach at your resort — a dedicated table for two set with candles and lanterns, featuring a chef's special menu of lobster thermidor, truffle risotto, and a custom honeymoon dessert platter.

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescence is most vivid on moonless nights — check the lunar calendar with your concierge to optimize timing. The cultural village tour is respectful and immersive — modest clothing recommended when visiting the local island (cover shoulders and knees).

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated spa morning — begin with a couple's 'Ocean Ritual' at the overwater spa: a full-body coconut and sea salt scrub followed by a deep-tissue Balinese massage, and end with a warm stone therapy session. Completely rejuvenating and utterly indulgent.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private sandbank picnic experience — your butler arranges a private transfer to a deserted sandbank in the middle of the lagoon. A luxury picnic is set up with a canopy, plush cushions, chilled Champagne, fresh seafood, and tropical fruit. Swim, snorkel, and sunbathe in complete seclusion with nothing but ocean in every direction.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a relaxed evening. Enjoy sundowner cocktails at your villa's private deck, followed by a casual dinner at the resort's casual dining venue.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-spa breakfast in-villa — fresh fruit, granola with coconut yogurt, herbal teas, and cold-pressed juices.
meals.lunch: Private sandbank picnic — curated gourmet spread of chilled prawns, smoked salmon blinis, artisan cheeses, fresh fruit, and Champagne arranged by the resort chef.
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's casual beachfront bistro — fresh fish tacos, Asian-spiced noodle bowls, and mango sorbet for dessert. Relaxed atmosphere with ocean soundtrack.

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank picnic is one of the most romantic experiences in the Maldives — request rose petals or a honeymoon banner from the concierge for an extra special touch. Bring reef-safe sunscreen and a hat as there is no shade on the sandbank.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling session at the resort's house reef — this time focus on the deeper sections of the reef with a guided underwater naturalist who points out rare species such as ghost pipefish, nudibranch, and octopus. Followed by a relaxed swim in the villa pool.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private dolphin watching cruise — board a private speedboat and head into the open ocean where pods of spinner dolphins are frequently spotted. Watch them leap and spin alongside the bow of the boat in their natural habitat. The cruise also includes a stop at a pristine outer reef for a final snorkel.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne (second experience) — this time sail toward the western horizon for a different vantage point. Toast to your honeymoon, watch the sunset, and enjoy a curated selection of canapés and fine wines on the open water.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast — indulge in freshly made waffles, eggs cooked to order, smoked salmon, and freshly squeezed juices.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's poolside bar — lobster rolls, truffle fries, and tropical fruit smoothies.
meals.dinner: Chef's table experience at the resort — a private 7-course degustation dinner prepared tableside by the executive chef, with wine pairing for each course. Intimate and extraordinary.

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin sightings are very common in North Malé Atoll but are not guaranteed — best chances are in the late afternoon. The chef's table experience requires advance booking and is available for a limited number of guests per evening.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely morning at your own pace — sleep in, enjoy a long breakfast, and simply do nothing. Spend time reading on your villa deck, floating in your private pool, or strolling the beach. True luxury is the freedom to rest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Watersports afternoon — enjoy complimentary or bookable premium watersports at the resort: try jet skiing, stand-up paddleboarding, or a thrilling parasailing ride above the lagoon for breathtaking aerial views of the atoll and its turquoise waters.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk & Stargazing (second session if weather allows, or substitute with a private movie night on the beach) — the resort sets up a private outdoor cinema on the sand with a large screen, plush sun loungers, popcorn, and blankets. Choose your favorite film under the stars.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — freshly baked croissants, smoked salmon bagels, acai bowls, and a full pot of specialty coffee.
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch at the resort — grilled chicken salad, fresh sushi platter, and chilled coconut water.
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant dinner — enjoy a romantic candlelit dinner with floor-to-ceiling views of the moonlit ocean. Order the catch of the day prepared in the style of your choice.

day_by_day.notes: Midpoint of the trip — check in with the concierge to confirm all remaining bookings and make any adjustments. This is a great day to simply recharge and enjoy the resort's facilities at a slow pace.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning deep-sea fishing excursion — board a private fishing boat before sunrise and head into deeper waters to try your hand at traditional Maldivian line fishing. The experience includes all equipment, a knowledgeable local guide, and the option to have your catch prepared by the resort chef for dinner.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by mid-morning. Spend the afternoon at the resort's overwater spa — book individual treatments such as a hot stone massage, deep cleansing facial, or reflexology session to soothe any muscle tension from the active morning.
day_by_day.evening: Coral Reef Snorkeling Safari at Maaya Thila (evening/twilight session if available) — experience the reef at dusk when nocturnal creatures begin to emerge, including moray eels, sleeping parrotfish, and hunting reef sharks. An entirely different and thrilling perspective of the reef.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing breakfast — energy bars, fresh fruit, and coffee prepared by your butler before dawn departure.
meals.lunch: Late brunch at the resort upon return — eggs Florentine, avocado and prawn toast, and tropical fruit platters.
meals.dinner: Your freshly caught fish prepared by the resort's executive chef in a style of your choosing — grilled whole with lemon butter, curried Maldivian style, or sashimi-grade sliced raw. Served on your private villa deck with wine.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm the morning fishing departure time with the concierge the night before. The catch-to-table dinner is a unique and memorable experience — inform the chef of any dietary preferences when booking.

day_by_day.morning: Guided snorkeling at a nearby coral restoration site — several resorts in North Malé Atoll partner with marine conservation programs. Join a marine biologist for a snorkeling session where you can plant a coral fragment on a restoration frame, contributing to reef recovery while learning about the ecosystem.
day_by_day.afternoon: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class (if not done previously, or visit a different local island) — explore the authentic side of Maldivian life, browse local craft markets, and pick up handmade souvenirs such as lacquerwork boxes and woven mats.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic in-villa dinner — your butler arranges a fully private dining setup on your villa deck or in your plunge pool area. The chef crafts a personalized menu based on your preferences, complete with Champagne, floating candles, and floral arrangements.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast — a leisurely spread with everything from freshly made dosas to continental classics and freshly brewed specialty coffee.
meals.lunch: Local island lunch during the cultural tour — fresh Maldivian short eats, samosas, and sweet black tea at a local café.
meals.dinner: Private in-villa dinner — personalized 5-course menu by the resort chef, featuring your favorite dishes from the week, paired with a sommelier-selected wine flight.

day_by_day.notes: The coral planting activity is a meaningful way to give back to the environment. Ask the resort for a certificate of your coral planting contribution as a keepsake. The in-villa dinner is a highlight for couples — book at least 24 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Seaplane scenic flight over the atolls (optional premium add-on) — book a short seaplane excursion for a bird's-eye view of the Maldives' iconic ring-shaped atolls, turquoise lagoons, and scattered islands. One of the most breathtaking perspectives of the archipelago available.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience (second visit or alternative luxury dining venue) — if you wish to revisit, request a different seating time or a special honeymoon menu. Alternatively, enjoy a lavish afternoon tea service in your villa, with finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream, and Champagne.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's overwater bar, followed by a stargazing session on the beach. The resort's astronomy guide sets up telescopes and narrates the Southern Hemisphere's constellations — a peaceful, romantic end to the evening.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — fresh fruit smoothie bowls, eggs any style, Maldivian fish curry with roshi, and specialty coffee.
meals.lunch: Gourmet underwater restaurant lunch or in-villa afternoon tea — decadent and indulgent.
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main fine-dining restaurant — choose from a seasonal à la carte menu featuring premium ingredients flown in from around the world, paired with an extensive wine list.

day_by_day.notes: Seaplane flights are subject to weather and availability — book well in advance through the resort concierge. Seaplanes typically operate only during daylight hours. This is a great day to purchase any last-minute gifts or souvenirs from the resort boutique.

day_by_day.morning: Final deep-dive snorkeling session at the house reef — take your time exploring every corner of the reef you've come to know over the past days. Bring an underwater camera to capture the marine life one last time. Followed by a relaxing float in the lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Couples' cooking class at the resort — join the resort's head chef for a private Maldivian and fusion cooking class in the resort kitchen. Learn to prepare signature dishes that you can recreate at home, including fresh coconut curry, grilled fish with island spices, and a tropical dessert.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne (final sunset cruise) — mark the near-end of your honeymoon with one last golden sunset on the Indian Ocean. Toast to your journey, your love, and the memories made on this extraordinary trip.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast — enjoy the full spread one more time, savoring every detail.
meals.lunch: Dishes prepared during the cooking class, enjoyed together in the resort's private dining area with a glass of chilled white wine.
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — a special honeymoon menu arranged by the concierge, complete with a personalized dessert message and a complimentary bottle of Champagne.

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort to prepare a personalized honeymoon memory book or photo album as a keepsake — many luxury resorts in the Maldives offer this service. Begin light packing this evening to avoid a rushed final morning.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk along the beach — wake up early one last time to watch the sun rise over the Indian Ocean. Collect a few shells or take a quiet moment to absorb the beauty of this place. Followed by a slow, indulgent breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort leisure day — use the remaining time to enjoy any resort amenities you haven't yet tried: the infinity pool, the gym, the resort library, or simply hammock-lounging between palm trees. Optional: book a final 60-minute massage at the spa.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk & Stargazing (final night, weather permitting) — one last magical walk along the glowing beach, hand in hand. A perfect, unforgettable final evening in the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Special farewell in-villa breakfast prepared by your butler — a grand spread of your favorite dishes from the trip, presented beautifully on your deck.
meals.lunch: Casual poolside lunch — fish burgers, tropical salads, fresh juices, and ice cream.
meals.dinner: Relaxed beachfront dinner at the resort's casual grill — grilled prawns, wood-fired pizza, and a shared dessert platter to celebrate the final night.

day_by_day.notes: Complete resort checkout formalities this evening if possible to allow for a smooth morning departure. Confirm speedboat transfer time to the airport with the concierge. Leave a review or thank-you note for the resort team who made your honeymoon extraordinary.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy a last quiet breakfast on your villa deck as the Maldivian sun rises over the lagoon. Take a final dip in your private plunge pool or a last walk along the beach. Check out of the villa and bid farewell to the resort team.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private speedboat transfer back to Velana International Airport, Malé. Arrive with ample time for check-in and enjoy the airport's premium lounge facilities before your departure flight. Carry with you memories, photographs, and perhaps a jar of local Maldivian honey or artisan crafts as souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Malé — carry the warmth of the Maldives in your hearts as you fly home from one of the world's most romantic destinations.

meals.breakfast: Final in-villa or restaurant breakfast — keep it light and enjoyable: fresh fruit, yogurt, pastries, and coffee.
meals.lunch: Airport VIP lounge dining or a light meal at a Malé airport restaurant before departure.
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or at the layover destination.

day_by_day.notes: Departure day — allow at least 2–3 hours before your flight for the speedboat transfer and airport check-in. The speedboat transfer from North Malé Atoll to the airport takes approximately 20–45 minutes depending on sea conditions. Double-check all luggage, passports, and travel documents before leaving the resort.

query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026
